entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Lucius Cassius Hemina was a Roman historian who chronicled the events of his time in his work 'The History of Rome'.

Born into a noble family in 180 BCE, Hemina's life took a dramatic turn when he became embroiled in the tumultuous reign of the Roman general Sulla.

Hemina's experiences during this period led him to write 'The History of Rome', which offered a fresh perspective on the traditional narrative of Roman history.

As a result, Hemina's work had significant regional impact on the understanding of Roman history and culture, influencing subsequent historians and scholars for centuries to come.
